datasets.name: DepositsData
datasets.sql:
select 
       cont.id,
       cont.contractno,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(acc.contractaccid) as ContractAccNO,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccount(acc.interestaccid) as InterestAccNO,
       av.val_name,
       sbcm_stored_programs.Get_ContractAccountName(acc.contractaccid) as CustomerName,

       --sbcm_stored_programs.get_CustomerNameByID(cont.customerid) as CustomerName,
       --sbcm_stored_programs.get_customername(acc.contractaccid) as CustomerName,
       cont.opendate,
       cont.closedate,
       cont.amount,
       cont.amount*tmp.ostat as ekamount,
       intr.interest,         
       cstate.facticaldebt,
       cstate.facticaldebt*tmp.ostat as ekfacticaldebt,
       cstate.facticalinterestdebt,
       cstate.facticalinterestdebt*tmp.ostat as ekfacticalinterestdebt,
       cstate.stopcalculationdate,
       --SBCM_Stored_Programs.CheckContractState(cont.ID) as  Status,
       cont.currency,
       cont.personaltype,
       cont.clienttype,
       cont.branchid,
       cont.contracttype,
       cstate.calculationenabled as status,
       cont.customerid,
       cont.sid# as usid
from sbcm_contracts cont,
     sbcm_contract_accounts acc,
     sbcm_interests intr,
     sbcm_contract_state cstate,
     avalute av,
     temprate tmp
where acc.id# = cont.id and
      intr.id# = cont.id and
      cstate.id# = cont.id and
      cont.currency = av.valute and
      cont.currency = tmp.val_kod and 
      cont.type# = 4 --Archive deposits
 order by :OrderField

datasets.name: Filials
datasets.sql:
select id,name from 
filial
order by id

datasets.name: Tranches
datasets.sql:
SELECT id, hdate, total, trid
  FROM sbcm_tranches
  where id# = :ContractID
order by hdate

datasets.name: DepositInfo
datasets.sql:
select
     cust.name,
     intr.interest,
     cont.amount,
     cont.currency,
     cont.customerid
from customers cust,
     sbcm_interests intr,
     sbcm_contracts cont
where
cont.id = :ContractID and 
cust.id = cont.customerid
and intr.id# = :ContractID

datasets.name: Payments
datasets.sql:
SELECT id,  hdate, facticaldebt, interestdebt,bankdebt,bankinterestdebt,overduedebt,overdueinterestdebt,trid, inttrid,befointtrid
  FROM sbcm_payments
  where id# = :ContractID
order by hdate
